common.generationMethod: Authored exclusively from preserved source literals, D14 and explicit new policy. No editor/candidate/regex execution or output sampling.

allCasesRequire.document: Exact canonical/profile structure, untouched outside scalar sequence, marks/attrs/links/opaque node identities; new native full-object goldens must be authored separately, never copied from candidate output.
allCasesRequire.originalSelection: Admit original directed UTF16/EGC endpoints before lexical widening. Reversed endpoints must yield same content with prescribed collapsed resulting caret.
allCasesRequire.expectedOrdinaryCommit: When admitted nonempty insertion changes content: exactly1 document publication/revision step,1 isolated undo unit; new caret at end of inserted cooked or literal result. Empty collapsed insertion:0.
allCasesRequire.history: One Undo to exact pre-trigger model/selection, one Redo to cooked/literal result. Special reversal histories use explicit rows.
allCasesRequire.resources: Original native resources and receipt lifecycle checked separately, no retained receipt after invalidation/destroy; no full export/readback per key.
allCasesRequire.nativeIdentityBinding: No fixture may substitute live candidate-generated IDs/canonical expected data. Before runtime, independent native author must bind existing source-contract allocator/normalizer identities or closed symbolic captures with explicit preservation/recreation predicates. This matrix deliberately does not pretend text-only CMS tests contain those unknown physical identities.
